title: Environments / current Unreal baseline
summary: Current lit editor captures of the permitted lobby, service and Basement spaces, LaCarlota and the shared Main_Lights setup. The new isolated material-review level supplements the existing showcase. These images document current implementation, including unfinished assignments. [Capture notes](REFERENCE_LIBRARY.md).

items.title: Lobby / entry connection
items.alt: Lobby / entry connection in the current Unreal editor
items.body:
**Unreal map:** `/Game/Levels/Inteior_Lobby`

**Capture:** 2026-11-17 · lit editor viewport · persistent world `/Game/Levels/Inteior_Lobby` with `/Game/Levels/Streaming_Levels/Main_Lights` loaded. These are editor images, not gameplay captures.

**Camera:** (-2400, -400, 170) cm; pitch -1°, yaw 90°, roll 0°; FOV 75°

**Source relationship:** Existing saved Unreal level and its native mesh/Blueprint/material consumers; Building pieces trace to `Assets/Building/Interior_Building.blend`.

**Intended use / observations:** The present lobby has unfinished WorldGrid wall/ceiling assignments. Use this capture for architecture and connections; the intended polished public finish is still an art direction, not current implementation.

**Review:** Native baseline verified; artistic approval is separate. Production levels were not saved.

items.title: Main_Lights / shared native setup
items.alt: LaCarlota rendered with the shared Main Lights setup
items.body:
**Unreal level:** `/Game/Levels/Streaming_Levels/Main_Lights`. **Capture:** 2026-11-17, lit editor viewport in `/Game/Levels/LaCarlota`; the same image is also shown in the cleaning-tool entry.

**Verified setup:** DirectionalLight, ExponentialHeightFog, PostProcessVolume, SkyAtmosphere and SkyLight. This is a shared lighting sublevel, not a standalone furnished environment. Basement Blueprint lights remain in Basement.

**Intended use:** Read environment captures in their actual shared lighting context. Its five native actors and both persistent-map load relationships were inspected. No lighting values or existing levels were saved. Artistic approval is separate.

items.title: Material review / isolated comparison rig
items.alt: The new native material comparison rig
items.body:
**Unreal level:** `/Game/Levels/Art_Material_Reference`. **Capture:** 2026-11-17 · native editor viewport, 55° FOV.

**Scale:** 2 m panel, 1 m cube, 1 m diameter sphere, 1 m panel, from left to right. The same existing MI is assigned to all four shapes. Neutral ground/backdrop and fixed white directional/cubemap lighting provide consistent comparisons. Glass stations include contrast bars.

**Source:** [Editable setup script](../../projects/total-insanitation/scripts/unreal_reference_showcase.py), with a review-only helper material under `/Game/Art/Tools/MaterialReference`. Reopened and verified: 88 materials, 352 assignments.

**Intended use:** Material choice for later designs. Comparison UVs are not production texel-density calibration. No existing material instance, mesh or level was changed. Artistic approval remains separate.
